ug.title: Wingate University - Undergraduate Admissions (rolling admission, test-optional, school codes)

cost.title: Wingate University - Cost: 2026-2027 tuition, fees, housing and meal plan

test_policy.notes: Wingate advertises 'test score optional'. The recommended application items are a self-reported GPA and an SAT, ACT or CLT score; applicants who cannot provide a score are asked for a 250-word personal essay instead. The international page says to submit official test scores 'if applicable'.

requirements.notes: No application fee. International applicants also email a passport copy and have a school official send the official high school transcript to internationaladmissions@wingate.edu. After admission: $100 non-refundable international processing fee, then a $2,500 enrollment and tuition deposit ($300 enrollment + $2,200 tuition deposit) before the I-20 is issued. Decision within two weeks of a complete file. Applicants must be at least 17 by the first day of class.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 entry
deadlines.notes: The page gives 'fall semester applications must be received no later than June 1' with no year, so the year is assumed to be 2027 for fall 2027 entry. Spring applications by Nov 1. Domestic first-year admission is rolling with no deadline.

deadlines.label: Recommended deadline for all I-20 documents (fall entry)
deadlines.notes: Wingate recommends all I-20 documentation be submitted by July 1 for fall (Nov 1 for spring). The page gives no year, so 2027 is assumed.

english_policy.waiver_notes: English proficiency is required before the I-20 is issued rather than for the admission decision. Exempt: citizens of listed English-speaking countries; 3+ years at a high school (international or American) taught in English with a school letter or transcript; or 24 transferable US college hours with a C or better in English composition. Otherwise any one of: SAT EBRW 450, ACT Reading and English 17 each, ELS level 112, ELTI (UNC Charlotte) level 6, or the test scores listed. Scores must be under 24 months old.

english.notes: The English Proficiency section lists 'TOEFL iBT 70'.
The Student Visa Information section of the same page lists 'TOEFL iBT score of 4'; the page does not name the 1-6 scale, but 4 cannot be on the 0-120 scale.

cost.notes: Traditional undergraduate: tuition $21,918 per semester; required fees $225 per term (health & wellness $100, student activity $100, technology $25); international student fee $100 per term; standard residence hall $3,592 + standard meal plan $2,302 + NC meal plan tax $155.39 per term (annual room and board rounded). Program fees (e.g. nursing, labs) are extra

aid.notes: Admitted international students are awarded a merit scholarship; the page says these 'can range from $15,000 - $30,500' but are not guaranteed, and there are no full-ride awards. Additional aid is available through the Alternative Financial Aid Application (amounts not published). Most students must show $30,000-$49,000 in funds for the I-20, depending on scholarship.
